title: Psalm 142
opening_line: I with my voice cried to the LORD,

text.diplomatic: my trouble I expressed.

text.diplomatic: When in me was o’erwhelmed my spirit,

text.diplomatic: then well thou knew’st my way;
text.normalized: Then well thou knew’st my way;

text.diplomatic: Where I did walk a snare for me

text.diplomatic: they privily did lay.

text.diplomatic: but none to know me were;
text.normalized: But none to know me were;
text.reading: but none to know me were;

text.diplomatic: All refuge failèd me, no man
text.normalized: All refuge failèd me, no man

text.diplomatic: did for my soul take care.
text.normalized: Did for my soul take care.

text.normalized: I cried to thee; I said, Thou art

text.diplomatic: my refuge, LORD, alone;
text.normalized: My refuge, LORD, alone;
text.reading: my refuge, LORD, alone;

text.diplomatic: And in the land of those that live
